content:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem about yesterday's cache eviction spike. I listed three remediation actions below. Need owners, JIRA links, and a short RACI. Can folks confirm owners by EOD?

alex: Actions: 1) persistent cache TTL audit & policy, 2) eviction backpressure fix (throttling/batching), 3) cross-region failover runbook + automated test.

priya: I'll own #1 (TTL audit). I'll create the JIRA now.

luke: I'll take #2 if Eng-Infra supports kernel/queue tuning. @maria can you be C for #2?

maria: I can consult on #2 but my bandwidth is limited this sprint. If timeline slips 2w I can be more hands-on.

devon: I'll pick #3 (runbook + tests). I'll add a checklist and a rollback plan.

priya: Created REDWOOD-8419 for TTL audit: https://jira.company/REDWOOD-8419. ETA 2026-04-10. Added repro steps.

alex: RACI quick ref: R=owner, A=approver, C=consulted, I=informed.

luke: Proposed RACI: #1 R=Priya, A=Alex, C=Eng-Infra (Maria), I=Support+SRE. #2 R=Luke, A=Eng-Platform lead (TBD), C=Maria, I=Ops. #3 R=Devon, A=Product, C=SRE, I=Oncall.

maria: A for #2 is OK if infra is looped early.

devon: REDWOOD-8421 created for runbook/tests: https://jira.company/REDWOOD-8421. ETA 2026-04-05.

opsbot: Reminder: tag tickets with `component=postmortem` and `severity=sev3`.

alex: Quick CLI snippet to create a ticket:
/jira create --project REDWOOD --summary "TTL audit for persistent cache" --component postmortem

priya: Noted a recurring pattern: evictions spike when a few customers send very long sequences. Added repro and prompt set to REDWOOD-8419.

luke: I'll open REDWOOD-8430 for monitoring: alert on per-customer 95p token-length > threshold over 5m.

maria: Proposed due dates if owners confirmed: #1 due 2026-04-10, #2 due 2026-04-17, #3 due 2026-04-05. Workable?

alex: Works for me. I'll update the postmortem doc and calendar invites. Please add blockers to the JIRAs. Thanks :thumbsup:

priya: :thumbsup: I'll post updates in the ticket.

devon: I'll add automated test cases to REDWOOD-8421 by EOD tomorrow.

luke: I'll follow up with eng-infra for allocation to investigate kernel/queue behavior.

maria: Ping me to escalate if you need more capacity.

alex: I'll mark this thread the canonical follow-up once tickets have owners and dates. Closing loop after JIRA links are finalized.
